label: late-episode D1: reward from S1 following an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D1 steps where the reward input is 1 (100% of mass; never at GO/D2 or after no reward) and only late in the episode (ep_trial >= ~55; 59% of mass in trials 90-99, rate grows with trial index). Within that, it prefers rewards that break an unrewarded run (previous trial unrewarded) and rewards earned in S1 (prev_state == 1; good == S1 and upcoming a1 enriched). Low model value is a strong correlate (60% of mass in the lowest value bin, none above 7.7). The top activations are a reward in S1 right after a rare-rewarded a2->S1 trial, followed by a switch to a1. It does not fire on rewards during a run of rewards (high value). All predicate variables are observed. The broad gate (D1 & reward & ep_trial >= 70) gets mass recall 0.98 at precision 0.17. The recorded conjunction trades recall for precision (dev P 0.74, R 0.47, F1 0.57). Magnitude grows with trial index and with low value.
